mostWorthwhile.text: Making the coarse pebble shore was most worthwhile: it connected abrasion with the sorting that leaves heavier stones at the headland.

leastWorthwhile.text: The extra transport step before depositing sand was initially confusing, although it clarified how the beach formed.

surprise.text: The sand had to move along the coast before it could accumulate in the sheltered bay; a beach is a moving store of sediment, not a permanent pile.

arbitrary.text: Using the cracked volcanic crust rather than the fractured headland to free stones felt unclear from the names, though compatibility feedback completed the action.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in another chapter that connects visible landscape features to physical processes as this one did.
